import unittest
from lsm.engine import LSMTree

class TestLSM(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lsm_ops(self):
        tree = LSMTree(memtable_threshold=2)
        tree.put('k1', 'v1')
        tree.put('k2', 'v2')  # triggers flush
        self.assertEqual(tree.get('k1'), 'v1')
        tree.delete('k1')
        self.assertIsNone(tree.get('k1'))

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
